hints.title: Creating a ScheduledExecutorService
hints.content: Use `ScheduledExecutorService scheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();` — this is the Java equivalent of a coroutine dispatcher with a single background thread.

hints.title: Scheduling a repeating task
hints.content: Call `scheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> { cachedDistance.set(frontSensor.getDistance(DistanceUnit.CM)); }, 0, 20, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);` — the 0 means start immediately, 20ms between each run.

hints.title: Letting the first read complete
hints.content: After calling scheduleAtFixedRate, sleep for 50ms with `Thread.sleep(50)` so the scheduled task has time to run at least once before your main code reads the cache.
